svg.title: Slide 12 interface wireframe (2 of 2)
svg.desc: Interface screenshot redrawn as a standardized wireframe: 1 button, 44 row separators, 13 icons, 188 text rows. 184 of 188 text rows carry text transcribed from the screenshot (OCR, approximate); the rest render as placeholder bars; positions are approximate to the source image and colours are mapped to the corpus palette.
